text.title: Fork of Spears
text.body: The Fork of Spears marks the gateway into the Sunless Deeps. Break through the entrenched enemy spearheads holding the crossroads and force the passage into the subterranean abyss.
text.obj.0: Breach the fortress courtyard by either the west or east route
text.msg.1: Two roads climb the fork—choose the marsh causeway or the ridge road, and brace for the inner courtyard.
text.msg.2: The west causeway is clear. The western fortress gate stands ahead!
text.msg.3: The east ridge guard is broken. The eastern gate lies open!
text.msg.4: Inside the courtyard! Watch the upper terrace—reserve packs are counterattacking!
text.msg.5: The Ironheart Bulwark cracks apart! With the colossus down, the highland war is broken.
text.win: The Ironheart Bulwark is shattered and the Fork of Spears falls to Thornvael.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen beneath the walls of Ironheart Bastion.
